arxiv-2201-10447.title: Differentially Private Temporal Difference Learning with Stochastic Nonconvex-Strongly-Concave Optimization
arxiv-2201-10447.creator: Canzhe Zhao, Yanjie Ze, Jing Dong, Baoxiang Wang, Shuai Li
arxiv-2201-10447.description: Abstract Temporal difference (TD) learning is a widely used method to evaluate policies in reinforcement learning. While many TD learning methods have been developed in recent years, little attention has been paid to preserving privacy and most of the existing approaches might face the concerns of data privacy from users.

arxiv-2303-10480.title: Pair production as a probe for the dynamics of nuclear fission and α \alpha decay
arxiv-2303-10480.creator: T. Settlemyre, H. Zheng, A. Bonasera
arxiv-2303-10480.description: Abstract Electron-positron pairs can be produced via the Schwinger mechanism in the presence of strong electric fields. In particular, the fields involved in α \alpha decay and nuclear fission are strong enough to produce them. The energy of the e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} pair is related to the relative distance and velocity of the daughter nuclei.

arxiv-2308-02743.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Spacecraft Inspection using Illumination Thanks: Approved for Public Release, Case Number AFRL-2023-1932. The views expressed are those of the authors and do not reflect the official guidance or position of the United States Government, the Department of De
arxiv-2308-02743.creator: David van Wijk, Kyle Dunlap, Manoranjan Majji, and Kerianne L. Hobbs
arxiv-2308-02743.description: Abstract This paper investigates the problem of on-orbit spacecraft inspection using a single free-flying deputy spacecraft, equipped with an optical sensor, whose controller is a neural network control system trained with Reinforcement Learning (RL). This work considers the illumination of the inspected spacecraft (chief) by the Sun in order to incentivize acquisition of well-illuminated optical data.

arxiv-2309-05413.title: Learning noise-induced transitions by multi-scaling reservoir computing
arxiv-2309-05413.creator: Zequn Lin, Zhaofan Lu, Zengru Di, Ying Tang
arxiv-2309-05413.description: Abstract Noise is usually regarded as adversarial to extract the effective dynamics from time series, such that the conventional data-driven approaches usually aim at learning the dynamics by mitigating the noisy effect. However, noise can have a functional role of driving transitions between stable states underlying many natural and engineered stochastic dynamics.

arxiv-2410-10186.title: A Possible Metal-Dominated Atmosphere Below the Thick Aerosols of GJ 1214 b Suggested by its JWST Panchromatic Transmission Spectrum
arxiv-2410-10186.creator: Kazumasa Ohno, Everett Schlawin, Taylor J. Bell, Matthew M. Murphy, Thomas G. Beatty, Luis Welbanks, Thomas P. Greene, Jonathan J. Fortney, Vivien Parmentier, Isaac R. Edelman, Nishil Mehta, Marcia J. Rieke
arxiv-2410-10186.description: Abstract GJ1214b is the archetype sub-Neptune for which thick aerosols have prevented us from constraining its atmospheric properties for over a decade. In this study, we leverage the panchromatic transmission spectrum of GJ1214b established by HST and JWST to investigate its atmospheric properties using a suite of atmospheric radiative transfer, photochemistry, and aerosol microphysical models.

arxiv-2505-12374.title: Lévy’s second arcsine law via the ballot theorem
arxiv-2505-12374.creator: Helmut H. Pitters
arxiv-2505-12374.description: Abstract We provide a new and elementary proof of Lévy’s second arcsine law for Brownian motion. The only tools required are basic properties of Brownian motion and Poisson processes, and the ballot theorem. Our proof is readily extended to Brownian motion with drift. Introduction.

arxiv-2505-17052.title: SpecEdge: Scalable Edge-Assisted Serving Framework for Interactive LLMs
arxiv-2505-17052.creator: Jinwoo Park, Seunggeun Cho, Dongsu Han
arxiv-2505-17052.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) power many modern applications, but serving them at scale remains costly and resource-intensive. Current server-centric systems overlook consumer-grade GPUs at the edge. We introduce SpecEdge, an edge-assisted inference framework that splits LLM workloads between edge and server GPUs using a speculative decoding scheme, exchanging only token outputs over the network.

arxiv-2602-18372.title: “How Do I …?”: Procedural Questions Predominate Student-LLM Chatbot Conversations
arxiv-2602-18372.creator: Alexandra Neagu and Marcus Messer and Peter Johnson and Rhodri Nelson
arxiv-2602-18372.description: Abstract Providing scaffolding through educational chatbots built on Large Language Models (LLM) has potential risks and benefits that remain an open area of research. When students navigate impasses, they ask for help by formulating impasse-driven questions. Within interactions with LLM chatbots, such questions shape the user prompts and drive the pedagogical effectiveness of the chatbot’s response.

pmc-10328293.title: Alexander disease: the road ahead
pmc-10328293.creator: María A. Pajares, Elena Hernández-Gerez, Milos Pekny, Dolores Pérez-Sala
pmc-10328293.description: Alexander disease is a rare neurodegenerative disorder caused by mutations in the glial fibrillary acidic protein, a type III intermediate filament protein expressed in astrocytes. Both early (infantile or juvenile) and adult onsets of the disease are known and, in both cases, astrocytes present characteristic aggregates, named Rosenthal fibers.

pmc-10607932.title: Characteristics of Age Classification into Five-Year Intervals to Explain Sarcopenia and Immune Cells in Older Adults
pmc-10607932.creator: Seung-Jae Heo, Yong-Seok Jee
pmc-10607932.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background and Objectives: This study focused on investigating sarcopenic factors and immune cells in older adulthood. To achieve this, the variables related to sarcopenia and immune cells in people living in the same community were analyzed.

pmc-10624676.title: To investigate the mechanism of Yiwei Decoction in the treatment of premature ovarian insufficiency-related osteoporosis using transcriptomics, network pharmacology and molecular docking techniques
pmc-10624676.creator: Weisen Fan, Yan Meng, Jing Zhang, Muzhen Li, Yingjie Zhang, Xintian Qu, Xin Xiu
pmc-10624676.description: To investigate the molecular mechanism of Yiwei Decoction (YWD) in preventing Premature ovarian insufficiency (POI)-related osteoporosis from the hypothalamic perspective , and to screen for the key active and acting molecules in YWD. Cyclophosphamide was used to create the POI rat model. Groups A, B, and C were established.

pmc-12649925.title: Comprehensive Metabolome and Transcriptome Analysis of Populus davidiana and Its Response to Drought Stress
pmc-12649925.creator: Yanmin Wang, Zhihui Yin, Haixia Li, Jing Li, Chengbo Guo, Zhenghua Li, Haifeng Zhang, Hongmei Wang, Hui Bai, Robert Henry
pmc-12649925.description: Simple SummaryDrought stress severely limits the growth and survival of poplars. The physiology, transcriptome, and metabolome of poplar trees under drought stress were thoroughly examined in this work. Major impacts on poplar physiological functions were identified, such as a decrease in chlorophyll content and an imbalance in ROS clearance.

pmc-12763841.title: Examining the roles, relationships and power dynamics shaping universal health system policy processes in high- and upper-middle-income countries: a scoping review
pmc-12763841.creator: Luisne Mac Conghail, Sarah Parker, Anne Matthews, Sara Burke
pmc-12763841.description: BackgroundPolicies for universal health systems aim to provide equitable access to quality healthcare. However, achieving this remains a complex goal in high and upper-middle-income countries. Despite widespread efforts, universal health system reforms vary significantly, shaped by historical, political, and economic contexts.

pmc-12959103.title: Unveiling an Uncommon Complication: Pleural Effusion Secondary to Pioglitazone Use
pmc-12959103.creator: Ranjana Chimauriya, Abhinandan Chittal, Khalid Malik, Tiffany DuMont, Christopher J. Haas
pmc-12959103.description: Pioglitazone, a peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPAR-γ) agonist, is used in the treatment of Type 2 diabetes mellitus by reducing insulin resistance. While peripheral edema and fluid retention are well-documented adverse effects, isolated pleural effusion in the absence of heart failure is rare.

pmc-13154400.title: High-performance 2D MoTe2-based photodetectors with superior Vis-NIR detection capability
pmc-13154400.creator: Xin Wang, Qingyu Zhou, Junkai Shen, Lin Lin, Hailing Tu, Guohu Zhang
pmc-13154400.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Photodetectors are crucial components for photoelectric conversion in intelligent sensing applications, and their performance can be significantly enhanced by using two-dimensional (2D) materials. In this study, we present a detailed investigation of 2H-MoTe2-based field-effect transistors (FETs) for photodetection. We demonstrate that air annealing at specific temperatures effectively improves charge transport properties by stabilizing the electrical polarity, enhancing transconductance by 230% and carrier mobility by 41%, primarily through defect healing in the MoTe2 lattice.

pmc-13221441.title: Appropriate Use of Single Inhaled Triple Therapy in Uncontrolled Asthma: A Multinational Modified Delphi Consensus
pmc-13221441.creator: Dilsad Mungan, Arturo Cortes-Telles, Mahmoud Mokhtar, Federico Daniel Colodenco, Martin Maillo, P K Thomas, Sanjeev Mehta, Mohamed S Al-Moamary, Hind Tahoon, Razia Hussain, James Van Hasselt, Nicola A Hanania
pmc-13221441.description: IntroductionUncontrolled asthma is associated with impaired lung function, higher frequency of severe exacerbations, reduced quality of life, and increased healthcare costs. Although inhaled corticosteroids with long-acting β2-agonists (ICS/LABA) form the cornerstone of treatment, many patients continue to experience suboptimal disease control. Despite additional therapeutic strategies, their utilization is inconsistent.

pmc-13244765.title: Mitral reoperations, reimagined
pmc-13244765.creator: Paola Keese Montanhesi, Arnar Geirsson, Daniel JP Burns, Gianluigi Bisleri
pmc-13244765.description: e surgery. The motivation is straightforward: to deliver safer operations, faster recovery, and durable outcomes. What follows reflects our collective experience and interpretation of the evolving evidence supporting the role of minimally invasive approaches in the setting of reoperations for mitral valve surgery. Minimally Invasive Mitral Valve Surgery Mitral valve surgery has come a long way.

pmc-13346401.title: Energy Expenditure of Esports Athletes During Gameplay: A Systematic Review
pmc-13346401.creator: Jiří Kotas, Edita Krejzová, Marta Gimunová, Michal Kumstát, Craig McNulty, Petr Babula
pmc-13346401.description: BackgroundAs competitive gaming continues its global rise, understanding the energy expenditure of esports athletes is essential for evaluating both performance demands and potential health risks. Esports—defined as organised, competitive video gaming—have rapidly expanded and are increasingly recognised as a legitimate form of sport, although debates about their classification remain.

pmc-13359328.creator: Shital H Patel, Eleni Panagiotakaki, Beiyu Liu, Carmen Fons, Lyndsey Prange, Maria T Papadopoulou, April Boggs, Elisa De Grandis, Aikaterini Vezyroglou, Francesco Fortunato, Simona Balestrini, Francesca Ragona, Eugenia Julia Tosi, Claudio Zucca, Giacomo Garone, Andrey Megvinov, Giosuè Lo Bosco, Mich

pmc-13474690.title: Machine learning-based prediction of postoperative atrial fibrillation risk in coronary artery bypass grafting patients
pmc-13474690.creator: Yang Zhang, Zhihan Zhang, Hu Zhang, Yun Lu, Zhu Wang, Jun Wei, Shoujie Feng
pmc-13474690.description: BackgroundPostoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) occurs in 20–40% of patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) and is associated with increased morbidity and mortality. Existing machine learning (ML) studies are limited by single‑center designs, small samples, and reliance on single algorithms.

pmc-13505301.title: Microfluidic-assisted metal nanoparticle synthesis: emerging trends toward optical sensing applications
pmc-13505301.creator: Trung Hieu Vu, Phuong Thy Nguyen, Ngoc Xuan Dat Mai, Ngoc Quang Tran, Thi Hoa Lai, Qiongzheng Hu, Nae Yoon Lee, Bach Thang Phan, Kieu The Loan Trinh
pmc-13505301.description: Metal nanoparticles have garnered significant attention due to their unique optical properties, which are highly advantageous in various sensing applications. While conventional batch synthesis methods often suffer from poor control over particle size and morphology, microfluidic synthesis has emerged as a powerful alternative, offering precise control over reaction parameters to synthesize monodisperse nanoparticles with tailored optical properties.

uslaw-usc-t15-s717b1.title: 15 U.S.C. § 717b–1 — State and local safety considerations
uslaw-usc-t15-s717b1.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s717b1.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 15B (Natural Gas). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Promulgation of regulations The Commission shall promulgate regulations on the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 (42 U.S.C. 4321 et seq.) pre-filing process within 60 days after August 8, 2005. An applicant shall comply with pre-filing process required under the National Environmental Policy Act.
